plugins.name: harvest-live
plugins.description: Harvest time tracking above the Claude Code prompt: suggests a project, task and description from the first prompt of each new chat and starts the timer in one press.

plugins.description: Interactive PR review with a HUD: PR summary, a verdict (including 'redo'), and issues one at a time with side-by-side diffs and option buttons. Bring your own review points or use the defaults.
